mission: Mission 4 item 3 (issue #273, owner 2026-11-09): snkrdunk-new-mappings picked up only two approve-snkr-batch applies by hardcoded reviewed_by values. An apply stores ops-write:approve-snkr-batch:<GITHUB_RUN_ID or local> (f1_approve.batch_reviewed_by, then lowercased). The diagnostic now matches that anchored pattern, so every later apply is included and approve-f1-batch, a longer runbook name, and a manual email are not. Read-only. No identity, pricing, fleet, or workflow change.

impacts.reason: SELECT-only diagnostic. batch and refused match reviewed_by with the anchored approve-snkr-batch pattern instead of two run ids. proposals is unchanged.
The apply label is built by batch_reviewed_by, the same ops-write:approve-snkr-batch:<run id or local> string the runbook already stored. The diagnostic pattern is batch_reviewed_by_pattern.

The pattern matches the two historical labels and the label the writer builds, and does not match approve-f1-batch, a longer runbook name, or manual reviewer values. The SQL file uses that pattern and stays SELECT/WITH.

impact.deployment_impact: None: a read-only report and the same approval label string.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: The report misses an approve-snkr-batch apply or includes another approval.

verification.observation_window: First ops-readonly db-diagnostic snkrdunk-new-mappings run after merge.
